lines.en: We're stuck on a roof with no picnic!
Never mind. We have the napkins.
You said it with your eyes.
We can still do the best part of a picnic.
Carly, why don't you want people to know about us?
Are you embarrassed to be with me?
My God, no. Not at all.
When that fedora flew off your head,
Look, I was in a public relationship with Beau,
and then he dumped me during that livestream,
'Cause I'm just worried that if we go public,
I'll be opening you up to that kind of pain.
You planning on dumping me anytime soon?
I just really want to protect you.
I don't know if you know this, but the Internet can be kind of mean.
You don't have to protect me, okay?
I can take whatever they throw at us.
Or we can keep it a secret forever.
I just want to be with you.
You are everything I have ever wanted.
And there's nothing that anyone on the Internet could ever say to make me feel differently.
Thank God I brought these napkins.
FYI, your camera's on, and it's not a flattering angle for Carly's chin.
I started streaming to show the drones and completely forgot.
I'm definitely not clicking away as fast as humanly possible.
I want the world to know.
I guess destroying the transmitter didn't work.
But they're making some kind of picture.
Yeah, they're spelling out Freddie for Evie with a beating heart.
It doesn't really look like a heart.
It looks more like a microphone.
I think I know what it is.
The drones must have gone back to their default formation.
Well, because apparently Spencer decided to test the drones by making a huge...
My lighthouse is on its side.
Can we just go back to you telling me you love me?
Yeah, I thought you'd never ask.
Okay, now I really see it.
You didn't happen to see a sick fedora on the street, did you?
We'll get you a new one.
And thanks for finally rescuing us.
Sorry I didn't hear my phone.
It was for totally normal reasons.
Unrelated, does anyone know where I can dump a giant possum corpse?
Cheers to publicly declaring your love.
